purpose: Discriminating finite-model pilot; not a held-out deployment evaluation
report_rule: Launches in episode t return before episode t+lag+1; lag is the configured lag for root Y=1 or child success=1, and zero otherwise.
timing: Within-episode physical arrivals and across-episode audit availability are different clocks.
statistics: Parameter updates use audit marks only. Operational observations and scalar episode costs are not additional training inputs.
exclusions: None. Empty confidence sets trigger a logged safe fallback. Every scheduled run is retained.
selection: Lexicographic ties for policy and model. No tuning after pilot outcomes. All 27 dictionary laws are checked by exact arithmetic; the three truth indices are a diagnostic subset, not a sampled workload.
